newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's bourse pursues upward trend.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's bourse pursues upward trend.

text.p: The Casablanca bourse on Thursday closed 0.98 percent higher in a market still illiquid, a stockbroker said.
The all-share index closed at 553.06 from 547.69 points on Wednesday.
"The market is more rational at least for the four stocks traded with the new electronic system, and, " a Wafa Bourse broker said.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, remained unchanged at 495 dirhams.
It showed a net profit of 366 million dirhams ($38.9 million) from 301 million dirhams, up 21 percent on the previous year.
Wafabank, soared 26 dirhams to close at 726.
BCM, one of Morocco's largest banks, rose 20 dirhams to close at 765.
It showed a net profit of 615.8 million dirhams ($66 million) in 1996, up 18.82 percent over the previous year, a bank official said.
"Increases in these three stocks can be attributed to their good annual results," he added.
Leasing firm Maroc-Leasing which was listed on the bourse late February gained 21 dirhams to 264. its initial price was 230 dirhams.
"This value is very illiquid, it might go higher," the broker said.
Credit firm Credor recently introduced on the Stock Exchange was up 10 dirhams to 645.
ONA Group, Morocco's largest private group advanced 10 dirhams to 705.
Traded volume on the official market was 70.3 million from 37.3 million dirhams on Wednesday, a stockbroker said.
